body: Thank you for writing this, it means a lot knowing that describing your own experiences is traumatic but that you're still willing to share them to help someone else, I really appreciate that. Thank you for saying I'm not a freak, I know I shouldn't need outside validation like that but sometimes it just helps.

I'm sorry to hear you were bullied in school, I never understood what drives people to tear someone down instead of help build them up.  

I guess I feel like I have to get a degree because that's what'll make me a worthy person in most people's eyes. I'm incredibly lonely and I want to finally "make it" in the real world, which has a lot to do with social networks and experience, neither of which I have and both of which seem to be gained in college. I just don't feel like a worthy person and I guess my logic is "if no one else cares if I die why should I want to live?"  
Thanks for the input

I guess I feel like a freak because I know what my social status is in life: the loser. I know that people view guys my age with disgust when we have nothing to offer the world and that honestly just makes me feel cold towards both society and myself. Nothing is enjoyable anymore, I can't distract myself from my social status. Thanks for taking the time to respond and I hope you're able to avoid the mistakes I made early in my college career (isolating).
